criteria.requirement: Add keyword-only when=None to actual naturalday/naturaldate, retaining their default current-date behavior and existing naturaltime.when. An explicit date is a calendar reference; explicit aware datetime converts into an aware value datetime timezone, date values use reference own date, and aware/naive datetime mismatch or invalid when is rejected explicitly before fallback handling. naturaldate year-threshold and delegated naturalday must use the same reference. Preserve invalid value pass-through, custom format, locale translation and extreme dates; prove fixed historical references and cross-midnight offsets without wall-clock waiting.
